title: Provenance-Aware Belief Updating in Human-AI Feedback Loops
abstract: arXiv:2610.13008v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In repeated human-AI interaction, a single observation can be quoted, summarized, and returned to a model as multiple reports, making repetition look like independent corroboration. We study whether language models can use supplied report lineage to update according to evidence provenance rather than report count. We introduce Latent Quotient Evidence Training (LQET), a relational objective that combines sparse Bayesian supervision with constraints that encourage stable predictions when reports add no new evidence and consistent updates to the same new evidence across relay histories. On a controlled binary benchmark, LQET reduces new-evidence update RMSE by 41-44% and log-odds drift after eight relay steps by 89-91% relative to task-only training across Qwen3-4B and Phi-4-mini, with three paired training seeds per backbone. The gains extend to a closed-loop simulation in which model confidence controls how many relayed reports re-enter

translated_title: 人机反馈循环中的溯源感知信念更新
translated_abstract: 在重复的人机交互中，单一观察结果可能被引用、总结，并以多条报告的形式返回给模型，使得重复信息看起来像是独立的佐证。我们研究语言模型能否利用所提供的报告谱系，依据证据的来源而非报告数量来进行更新。我们提出了潜在商证据训练，这是一种关系型训练目标，将稀疏贝叶斯监督与约束条件相结合，促使模型在报告未带来新证据时保持预测稳定，并在不同转发历史中对相同的新证据做出一致的更新。在一个受控的二分类基准测试中，在 Qwen3-4B 和 Phi-4-mini 两种模型上（每种骨干模型均采用三组配对训练随机种子），与仅使用任务训练相比，LQET 将新证据更新的均方根误差（RMSE）降低了 41-44%，并将八次转发步骤后的对数几率漂移降低了 89-91%。这些收益还延伸到一个闭环模拟中，其中模型置信度控制着多少转发报告重新进入系统。
tldr: 该论文提出LQET训练目标，使语言模型能够依据证据来源而非报告数量进行信念更新，显著降低了重复转发信息造成的虚假佐证与置信度漂移问题。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces LQET, a relational training objective that enables language models to update beliefs according to evidence provenance rather than report count, substantially reducing false corroboration and confidence drift caused by repeatedly relayed reports.
